title: Preface
summary: The text presents the policy wordings for the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy, including a table of contents that lists clauses A through K covering the insurance contract, insured events, home building and contents covers, additional covers, exclusions, conditions, changes to covers, waiver of underinsurance, other details, and grievances, along with their respective page numbers. It also provides the registered office address, 24*7 customer support contact number, email, website, IRDA registration number, CIN, policy UIN, and page numbering.

nodes.summary: The text outlines the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy, detailing Home Building Cover including definitions, residential use conditions, sum insured with automatic increases and restoration, claim payments for repairs, total loss, additional structures, and expenses like architect fees and debris removal. It covers Loss of Rent and Alternative Accommodation. Home Contents Cover is described with sum insured, built-in cover, restoration, and claim payments. Optional covers for Valuable Contents and Personal Accident are included, along with add-ons. Exclusions for all covers are listed, and policy conditions regarding obligations such as disclosure, care, and informing changes are specified.

summary: This section establishes the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy as a contract between the insured and insurer, detailing its components (policy document, schedule, endorsements, add-ons, proposals). It specifies to whom the policy is issued, covering the insured person(s), home building, and/or home contents, with provisions for joint policyholders and mortgaged properties via an 'Agreed Bank Clause'. It outlines the contents of the policy schedule, including personal details, policy period, property description, sum insured, covers, premium, and add-ons. Additionally, it defines special meanings for key terms used throughout the policy.

title: I. Your Obligations:
key_items: b. Take care to prevent theft, loss or damage to your Home Building and Home Contents, and
summary: The text outlines exclusions such as loss from removed property, consequential losses, market value reduction, unauthorized structural changes, and claim preparation costs. It details policy conditions including your obligations for full disclosure, property care, informing changes, claim cooperation, and truthful claims; renewal terms stating non-automatic renewal and application requirements; and cancellation/termination provisions covering cancellation by you or us, and automatic termination upon home destruction with options for continued cover.

title: II. Renewal of Policy:
summary: The text outlines the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy's conditions regarding claim cooperation and investigation, the necessity for truthful disclosures with penalties for fraud, renewal procedures including non-automatic renewal and application requirements, cancellation rights for both policyholder and insurer with refund provisions, automatic termination scenarios such as home destruction, and provides the insurer's contact and registration information.

title: III. Cancellation and Termination of Policy:
summary: The text outlines policyholder obligations for claim inspection and investigation, requiring cooperation, truthful disclosure, and document submission, with consequences for false information. It details policy renewal procedures, cancellation and termination conditions including cancellation by either party, automatic termination due to destruction, exhaustion of sum insured, change of use, sale, or death, and specifies the claims procedure requiring immediate notice with comprehensive details.

title: IV. Claims Procedure
key_items: c. You must state in this notice
summary: The text outlines policy termination conditions including exhaustion of sum insured, change of use, sale of property, and effect of death. It details claims procedure covering immediate notice, prevention of further loss, notice to authorities, claim submission, loss establishment, fraudulent claim consequences, other insurance, and recovery actions. It also covers changes to covers, waiver of underinsurance, and other details like notices, nomination, and applicable law.

title: Policy Changes, Underinsurance Waiver, Notices, Nomination, and Jurisdiction
summary: This page from the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy covers recovery from third parties, including application of recovered amounts and conditions for legal proceedings. It details Clause H on changes to covers requiring insurer acceptance and additional premium, and the entire contract components. Clause I waives underinsurance, so sum insured less than actual value does not affect claims. Clause J covers notices (insurer to insured's address/email; insured to branch office/policy address), nomination for claim on death (at inception or later, changeable via form), and applicable Indian law and jurisdiction. It also lists registered office, customer support, email, website, IRDA registration, CIN, UIN, and page number.

title: 3. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction:
summary: The text covers clauses from the TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy: recovery from third parties and legal proceedings; changes to covers and contract composition; waiver of underinsurance; notices; nomination; applicable law and jurisdiction; registered office and contact details; grievance redressal procedures including customer support, grievance redressal officer, nodal officer, and Insurance Ombudsman with an example office.

title: TATA AIG Policy Grievance Redressal and Ombudsman Contacts
key_items: Office of the Address & Contact Details Ombudsman
summary: The page outlines the grievance redressal process for TATA AIG Bharat Griha Raksha Policy, including contacting customer support via phone or email, writing to the Grievance Redressal Officer, and finding Nodal Officer details on the website. It also describes escalation to the Insurance Ombudsman under 2017 Rules and via the IRDAI Integrated Grievance Management System, provides the Ahmedabad Ombudsman office address and contact details for Gujarat, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu, and lists the registered office address and corporate contact information.
